deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout: shifting 5% traffic -> service:text-gen to version v2.14.0-canary. Change window 22:00-23:30 UTC. Rollout ID: r-2026-09-20-01
marie: ack. monitoring dashboards up? can someone paste latency + error snapshot for baseline?
engops: baseline (last 30m): p95 latency 110ms, 500s 0.12%, qps steady. sending links: https://graf/redwood/text-gen/heatmap
sam (oncall): @engops can you watch errors for first 10m and call stop if 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 3m?
luis (sre): added alert rule: canary-5pct-5xx >0.5% over 3m -> #incidents and page oncall.
anya: noted. bringing up verification job for prompt-formatting smoke tests (quick eval suite).
deploy-bot: traffic shift complete: 5% -> v2.14.0-canary. r-2026-09-20-01.
engops: quick snapshot (1m after shift): p95 115ms (+4%), 500s 0.18% (+0.06%). small blip, still below alert.
marie: running our sample eval set now. sending results in 2m.
engops: 3m after shift: p95 130ms, 500s 0.65% -> alert fired. paging #incidents.
sam (oncall): I see pages. rolling decision? calling for stop/hold.
marie: Eval shows formatting regression on a subset (n=9/200 prompts) — responses truncated. Confidence drop ~7%.
luis (sre): 5xx spike appears correlated to kvcache misses on v2.14.0 path. infra team looking into mem pressure on canary nodes.
anya: any quick rollback available? can we pin traffic back to v2.13.9?
deploy-bot: Rollback command available: `/deploy rollback --id r-2026-09-20-01 --to v2.13.9 --force` (requires two approvals).
marie: propose STOP. hold at 0% (shift back) and pin v2.13.9 while infra investigates.
sam (oncall): +1 stop. I've already muted canary alerts and will coordinate incident bridge.
luis (sre): +1. recommend pin old version to prevent auto-retry to canary during fix.
engops: initiating traffic revert now. deploy-bot: traffic shift in progress -> reverting 5% from v2.14.0-canary to v2.13.9.
deploy-bot: Traffic revert complete. Current traffic: 0% v2.14.0-canary, 100% v2.13.9.
anya: created issue infra#4521 with heap / kvcache dump links and attached failure traces.
marie: adding release-note blocker: revert and formatting regression. marking v2.14.0-canary as blocked for rollout.
sam (oncall): ops checklist: keep pinned to v2.13.9; do not resume until root cause triaged and a new canary build validated.
marie: who will own follow-up? assigning to @luis (sre) + @infra-team. will reconvene for a re-run when tests pass.
luis (sre): will own triage. opening postmortem stub and timeline.
engops: noted. closing this thread—final action: STOP, pin v2.13.9, open incident, block v2.14.0-canary. :no_entry_sign: :wrench:
